rationale: The agent verified the user by email via tool and confirmed identity. It gathered order addresses using read-only tools after consent, listed them, and asked the user to choose. Before making changes, it stated the exact updates (apply option 4 address to all pending orders and listed the order IDs) and obtained explicit confirmation. It then correctly updated only the pending orders (#W2166301, #W2466703, #W6832752) using the modify tool, and did not attempt to change delivered or processed orders. Final confirmation matched tool results. Although the meta prompt mentioned updating the default address too, the user did not request that in the conversation, so no policy breach. No unsupported statements or actions on another account occurred.
